mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (username, password, phone, status, role) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, password, status, role, create_time, update_time FROM account ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
